findings.resolution: The original delegation definition could imply that the portal performs no authorization evaluation. Clarified external identity/entitlement retrieval while preserving portal/application enforcement and the reported Auth Server scope.
Scoped machine-to-machine validity to the historical reference and kept it separate from credential rotation, current token policy and portal session ceilings.
Qualified the Auth Server index description so the reported provider list does not imply Entra SPN or EMS3 was identified in the inspected Auth copy.
Separated the named microfrontend role from unconfirmed organizational equivalence with Portal Team.
Scoped documented FMAA validation to recurring tenant-pipeline CSV uploads; the first UAT/Production bulk insert uses a separate BFF release.
